result.reason: Although the new language meets the fallback cap and carve-out formulation in isolation, the clause as a whole remains materially one-sided. The retained provisions make Licensee assume all risks and broadly excuse Licensor and its affiliates from direct and indirect liability except for gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Those provisions undermine the purported mutual cap and mutual damages exclusion and may also nullify practical recovery for other uncapped claims such as confidentiality, indemnification and IP infringement. The edit should conform or override all conflicting exculpatory language. Drafting is also weakened by the conflicting provisions, the awkward definition of claims by reference to conduct such as 'its gross negligence,' and the margin comment's inaccurate assertion that the provision has been made mutual.
